Openness.Description: Highly curious and creative, with a deep appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, and unusual ideas.

Conscientiousness.Description: Detail-oriented and organized, with a strong sense of duty and a methodical approach to tasks.

Extraversion.Description: Balanced between social interaction and solitude, preferring meaningful one-on-one conversations.

Agreeableness.Description: Compassionate and empathetic, with a genuine interest in helping others and maintaining harmony.

Neuroticism.Description: Experiences emotions deeply, with occasional anxiety about social interactions and outcomes.

Relations.Description: Forms deep, meaningful connections with others, particularly valuing trust and authenticity.

Other.Description: Thoughtful and reflective, with a strong desire to understand both self and others.
